measured_model.shared_console: Launcher run from a console, tool spawned with windowsHide:false, detached:false: the value is in the tool's environment block only; the launcher's own block, the depositor's block and every conhost block are clean.
measured_model.hidden_console: A launcher started with windowsHide:true (CREATE_NO_WINDOW) HAS a console without a window, so it passes OC-1; its tool shares that console; measured: no conhost carries the value.
measured_model.no_console: A launcher started DETACHED (no console at all, the B-1 hazard) is refused with CHANNEL_NO_CONSOLE before anything is read.
measured_model.negative_controls: A launcher build mutated to spawn the tool with windowsHide:true IS caught (a conhost carries the value); one mutated to write its own process.env IS caught (the launcher's block carries it).
